en: "Quick Convert"{SAUT}When the Party Meter is filled to a{SAUT}certain point, you can perform a {f 0 1 2}Quick{SAUT}Convert{f 0 1 0} by pressing the Y Button during{SAUT}the action of either an enemy or an ally.
A Quick Convert will automatically switch{SAUT}out your team at the end of the turn.
By the way, all of the team members that{SAUT}come into battle via Quick Convert will{SAUT}be feeling in top form, eager to fight!
Compared to an ordinary Team Convert,{SAUT}Quick Convert makes it easier to knock{SAUT}down Shadows.
